title: Python
tagline: Python for scripting, data and quick ideas
description: The fastest language to get an idea working in. Starting from the first line, the course covers values, strings and collections, loops and functions, modules and files, classes and errors, the idioms that make Python code short and clear, and finally working with text, CSV, JSON and dates to automate real tasks. Every lesson has checked practice that runs real Python 3.13, and every milestone ends with a project.

milestones.title: First Steps
milestones.blurb: Running Python, values and variables, input and output with f-strings, numbers, and making decisions.

lessons.title: What Python Is and Running Code
lessons.summary: Python is a language you can read almost like English and run without a separate compile step. This lesson explains what that means, runs a first program, and shows the two ways to run Python - scripts and the interactive prompt.

lessons.title: Values, Variables and Types
lessons.summary: Every value in Python has a type - int, float, str, bool, None - and variables are names that refer to values. This lesson covers assignment, naming, dynamic typing, converting between types and checking a value's type.

lessons.title: Input, Output and f-strings
lessons.summary: Programs that talk to the user - print with its separators and endings, input that always returns text, converting what was typed, and f-strings for building text with values and formatting numbers.

lessons.title: Numbers and Arithmetic
lessons.summary: Calculating in Python - the arithmetic operators, true division versus floor division, remainders, powers, precedence, the math module, and the surprises of floating-point numbers.

lessons.title: Decisions with if
lessons.summary: Making a program choose - comparisons, if, elif and else, indentation as structure, combining conditions with and, or and not, chained comparisons, the conditional expression, and match for many cases.

milestones.title: Collections and Loops
milestones.blurb: Strings in depth, lists, for and while loops, tuples and unpacking, dictionaries and sets.

lessons.title: Strings in Depth
lessons.summary: Working with text - indexing and slicing, the most useful string methods, splitting and joining, searching, escape sequences and raw strings, multi-line strings, and why strings cannot be changed in place.

lessons.title: Lists
lessons.summary: Python's general-purpose collection - creating lists, indexing and slicing, adding and removing items, sorting, searching, lists of lists, and the important difference between copying a list and naming it twice.

lessons.title: Loops: for and while
lessons.summary: Repeating work - for loops over lists, strings and ranges, enumerate and zip, while loops that run until a condition changes, break and continue, the loop else, and common loop patterns such as counting, accumulating and searching.

lessons.title: Tuples and Unpacking
lessons.summary: Tuples are fixed sequences for values that belong together - coordinates, records, several return values. This lesson covers creating them, unpacking with *, swapping, and when to choose a tuple over a list.

lessons.title: Dictionaries and Sets
lessons.summary: Looking things up by key with dictionaries - creating, reading with get, updating, looping over items, counting and grouping - and sets for unique values and fast membership, with union, intersection and difference.

milestones.title: Functions, Modules and Files
milestones.blurb: Writing functions, parameters and keyword arguments, scope and closures, modules and packages, and reading and writing files.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.summary: Packaging code under a name - def, parameters and return values, returning several values, functions without a return, docstrings, and why small functions with one job make programs easier to change and test.

lessons.title: Parameters and Arguments
lessons.summary: The flexible ways Python passes values to functions - positional and keyword arguments, default values and the mutable default trap, *args and **kwargs, keyword-only and positional-only parameters, and unpacking arguments.

lessons.title: Scope and Closures
lessons.summary: Where names live - local and global scope, the LEGB lookup order, global and nonlocal, functions defined inside functions, closures that remember values, and lambda expressions.

lessons.title: Modules and Packages
lessons.summary: Splitting a program into files - modules and import, the forms of import, the __name__ == "__main__" idiom, packages, how Python finds modules, the standard library, and installing third-party packages with pip in a virtual environment.

lessons.title: Files and Paths
lessons.summary: Reading and writing text files safely with with-blocks, reading line by line, encodings, appending, working with paths using pathlib, listing and finding files, and the difference between text and binary files.

milestones.title: Objects and Errors
milestones.blurb: Classes and objects, special methods, inheritance and protocols, dataclasses and enums, and exceptions.

lessons.title: Classes and Objects
lessons.summary: Bundling data and behaviour together - defining a class, __init__ and self, attributes and methods, class attributes, keeping an object valid, properties, and when a class is better than a dictionary or a few functions.

lessons.title: Special Methods
lessons.summary: Making your classes behave like built-in types - __repr__ and __str__ for printing, __eq__ and ordering, arithmetic operators, __len__, __getitem__ and __iter__ for containers, __contains__, and __hash__ for use in sets and as keys.

lessons.title: Inheritance and Protocols
lessons.summary: Sharing behaviour between classes - subclasses, overriding methods, super(), abstract base classes, and Python's duck typing, where any object with the right methods will do. This lesson also says when composition is better than inheritance.

lessons.title: Dataclasses and Enums
lessons.summary: Less boilerplate for data-holding classes - @dataclass generates __init__, __repr__ and __eq__, with defaults, field(default_factory), ordering, frozen instances and __post_init__ validation - and Enum for a fixed set of named values.

lessons.title: Errors and Exceptions
lessons.summary: Handling what goes wrong - reading tracebacks, try and except, catching specific exceptions, else and finally, raising your own errors, custom exception classes, and the difference between asking permission and asking forgiveness.

milestones.title: Pythonic Code
milestones.blurb: Comprehensions, iterators and generators, sorting with key functions, the standard library's toolbox, type hints and tests.

lessons.title: Comprehensions
lessons.summary: Building lists, dictionaries and sets in one readable expression - list comprehensions with conditions, nested comprehensions, dictionary and set comprehensions, conditional expressions inside them, and when a plain loop is clearer.

lessons.title: Iterators and Generators
lessons.summary: How for loops really work - iterables and iterators, iter and next, writing generator functions with yield, lazy pipelines that process data of any size, infinite sequences, and yield from.

lessons.title: Sorting, Key Functions and Lambdas
lessons.summary: Putting things in order - sorted and sort with key functions, sorting by several criteria, stable sorting, reverse order per field, operator.itemgetter and attrgetter, min and max with keys, and structural pattern matching on sequences.

lessons.title: The Standard Library Toolbox
lessons.summary: The modules that make everyday code short - collections (Counter, defaultdict, deque, namedtuple), itertools (chain, groupby, product, combinations, accumulate), functools (lru_cache, partial, reduce) and a few more worth knowing.

lessons.title: Type Hints and Testing
lessons.summary: Making Python code safer as it grows - type hints for functions, collections and optional values, checking them with mypy or Pyright, Protocols for duck typing - and automated tests with assert, pytest, fixtures and parametrised tests.

milestones.title: Data and Automation
milestones.blurb: Text processing and regular expressions, CSV and JSON, dates and times, automation scripts, and a complete data report tool.

lessons.title: Text Processing and Regular Expressions
lessons.summary: Finding and extracting patterns in text with the re module - the pattern language, search, findall and fullmatch, groups and named groups, substitution, flags, and when plain string methods are the better tool.

lessons.title: CSV and JSON
lessons.summary: The two data formats you meet everywhere - reading and writing CSV with the csv module (quoting, DictReader and DictWriter, converting types), and JSON with the json module (loading, dumping, pretty printing, and what maps to what).

lessons.title: Dates and Times
lessons.summary: Working with dates and times in Python - date, time, datetime and timedelta, parsing and formatting with ISO 8601 and strftime, date arithmetic, time zones with zoneinfo, and measuring durations with time.perf_counter.

lessons.title: Automation Scripts
lessons.summary: Turning Python code into tools you run every day - command-line arguments with argparse, exit codes, reading from standard input, working through folders of files safely, running other programs with subprocess, and logging what a script did.

lessons.title: Project: A Data Report Tool
lessons.summary: Bring the whole course together in a command-line tool that reads sales data from CSV, validates it, groups and summarises it by month and product, and writes a text report and a JSON file. This lesson is the design, the structure and the order to build it in.
